note: Complete safe list. Every spare SECOND scene screened against every CDVQA scene by 64-bit dHash, minimum over both dates. Safe means no CDVQA scene lies within the threshold.
threshold_basis: Calibration: spare scenes compared against each other, all distinct by construction, reach a minimum of 10 and a median of 17. The threshold of 12 therefore sits ABOVE the distinct-pair floor, which makes the screen deliberately conservative: it can drop a genuinely distinct scene, but cannot admit a near-duplicate. That is the right direction of error for a held-out screen. Note this corrects the earlier partial run, which recorded a floor of 13 from only 60 scenes; across all 1694 the floor is 10.
